reason: 64*1024 is only the scanner's initial buffer capacity. The mutation makes it 64/1024 = 0; bufio.Scanner then allocates its default 4096-byte buffer on first use and doubles it up to the same 1 MiB maximum, so every input scans identically. Confirmed empirically: with the mutation hand-applied the full package suite, including the 100 KiB line case, still passes.
